precommitted_rule: all three candidates and baselines are reported on every test; no selection by test outcome
response: signed dL_c = loss(config)_c - dense_c, in nats; no transform or clipping
standardization_rule: Natural logs of N0 and D0; population mean/std pooled over training response rows and capabilities, as in v53. Constant feature scale=1. Refit on training states in every LOSO fold. u_center is the training mean of log2(qmax); v=log2(g/128). Only phi covariates are z-scored; configuration factors are as specified.

ridge.interpolation_interpretation: Per-config OLS with the common fixed ridge, as in v53.

grids.selection: Minimum unpenalized dev SSE after ridge fitting; exact ties: smaller p, then q.

candidate_definitions.low_order_2d: phi.[a0 + a1*u + a2*v + a3*u*v + a4*u^2]; coefficients ordered by term then phi
candidate_definitions.same_input_interpolation: Independent four-vector per dev config. Bilinear in (log2(qmax), log2(g)), qmax=2**(b-1)-1, between the four dev anchors. Weights are not clipped: extend linearly outside either axis.
candidate_definitions.mean: Per-config mean of training dL. Bilinear in (log2(qmax), log2(g)), qmax=2**(b-1)-1, between the four dev anchors. Weights are not clipped: extend linearly outside either axis.
candidate_definitions.median: Per-config median of training dL. Bilinear in (log2(qmax), log2(g)), qmax=2**(b-1)-1, between the four dev anchors. Weights are not clipped: extend linearly outside either axis.
